title: Version 17.12.7
body_markdown:
*Released April 8th, 2025*

| Top bug fixes | From the community |
| --- | --- |
| Added support for modern TFVC Check-in Policies, as well as guidance and warnings when obsolete TFVC Check-in Policies are being applied. |  |
| VisualCppTools / ppltasks.h race condition bug in when\_any | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/VisualCppTools--ppltasksh-race-conditi/10813456) |
| Fixed arm64EC link failure unresolved external #\_guard\_dispatch\_icall\_$fo$ | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Arm64EC-missing-symbol-_guard_dispatch_i/10839928) |

| Security advisories addressed | CVE |
| --- | --- |
| Visual Studio node.js Untrusted Search Path Remote Code Execution Vulnerability | [**CVE-2025-29802**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2025-29802) |
| Visual Studio Android JDK Untrusted Search Path Remote Code Execution Vulnerability | [**CVE-2025-29804**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2025-29804) |
| ASP.NET Core 8 Denial of Service with HTTP/3 | [**CVE-2025-26682**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2025-26682) |
